policy: Each task requires independent reviewed evidence. Tasks are bounded work units, not time estimates. Split a large task further before implementation without dropping acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Freeze source and environment
acceptance: Create isolated oracle checkout at pinned SHA; record clean revision and complete build environment.
Verify eight critical source hashes and enumerate native/model dependency closure.
Record source-derived versus runtime-unresolved fields; no fabricated digest.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Reconcile full feature and API scope
acceptance: Reconcile annotated handlers with actual resource registration and documentation.
Classify current, optional, deprecated, inactive and asset-missing features including CLI/Java embedding.
Map each route/media variant and feature row to required runtime cases and tasks.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Build and start the Java oracle
acceptance: Build exact source with JDK 21 and pinned build inputs; record dependency failures and test discovery/pass/skip counts.
Start CRF service and establish isalive/health/model readiness; assert no partial model failures.
Record reproducible source-build/image digest; do not substitute an older release image.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Lock effective profiles and runtime assets
acceptance: SHA-256 actual model/native/lexicon/detector/embedding assets selected on each platform.
Dump effective config via the same getters for default/full/evaluation and flavors, including missing asset fallback.
Probe DeLFT underscore-name runtime lookup and disabled classifier behavior; preserve evidence.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Build legal versioned corpus and holdout
acceptance: Pin external dataset revision and actual eligible document/gold counts; retain licenses.
Select upstream, synthetic edge and optional user-authorized production examples with hashes and coverage tags.
Separate iterative development and held-out sets; no empty corpus counts as done.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Capture raw-text and HTTP baseline
acceptance: Capture raw date/name/affiliation/citation services and negotiation/default/error cases three times.
Verify request identity, expected statuses, meaningful headers and raw response hashes.
Validate starter harness with real Java cases and record baseline volatility.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Capture extractor and stage oracles
acceptance: Capture pdfalto argv/environment/sidecars, LayoutToken properties and feature/label/cluster structures.
Assert debugMode model names/invocation counts; instrument missing paths without changing outputs.
Repeat representative PDFs and isolate nondeterminism or malformed-input behavior.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Implement reviewed semantic output comparators
acceptance: Add only proven exact TEI provenance volatility; preserve publication dates and mixed content.
Implement generated-ID bijection/link invariants and PDF annotation object/render comparison as needed.
Add deliberate content/coordinate/link/asset mutations that fail; retain unnormalized evidence.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Capture complete service option matrix
acceptance: Cover all active routes, method/media variants and option/default/error boundaries including patents/training/admin.
Create pairwise interaction coverage plus exhaustive risky boundaries; list uncovered combinations.
Freeze response and stage manifests; no missing/empty/skipped mandatory cases.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Profile the real Java workload
acceptance: Measure cold/warm and stage times, queueing, total-process memory/CPU and external latency.
Declare primary workload/profile/hardware and acceptance before optimization.
Rank measured bottlenecks; do not infer Java is dominant from language choice.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Scaffold Rust workspace and CI
acceptance: Select available stable toolchain/dependencies and commit exact versions/lockfile.
Create architectural boundaries, release build, formatting/lints and meaningful test entrypoint.
Keep no stub endpoint/model behavior marked implemented; preserve upstream build separately.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port Java string and Unicode semantics
acceptance: Implement typed UTF-16/byte/scalar conversions and fixture-backed normalization/case/regex/number behavior.
Cover astral, combining, ligature, whitespace, RTL/CJK and prefix/suffix boundary cases.
Match Java utility outputs exactly before pipeline reuse.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port config and model/flavor resolution
acceptance: Load source-compatible configuration and reproduce per-getter inheritance/defaults.
Match effective engine/architecture/files and base fallback for every profile/flavor.
Validate missing assets, mixed engines and invalid paths against oracle; no generic deep merge.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Define lossless document and layout types
acceptance: Represent pages/blocks/tokens/graphics, all layout/style flags and typed spans.
Round-trip oracle snapshots without dropping order, null/empty values or coordinate precision.
Freeze reviewed shared interfaces before parallel parser work.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Audit Wapiti fork ABI and ownership
acceptance: Resolve actual native source revision corresponding to the binary and JNI wrapper.
Document callable C surface, allocators, lifetime, shared mutation and threading.
Choose safe shim/process boundary and minimal build; no unsupported Send/Sync assumptions.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Implement Wapiti label adapter
acceptance: Load same models and compare feature→label streams including output trimming/separators.
Test invalid assets, lifecycle/reload, concurrent calls and native error ownership.
Prove unsafe boundary with sanitizer/concurrency evidence where platform supports it.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port tokenizer lexicons and feature primitives
acceptance: Preserve token delimiters/whitespace and exact lexicon membership.
Port emitted feature column order, categories, prefixes/suffixes and numeric bins.
Golden-test sequence/line/block separators and encoding into the model boundary.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port date and name parsers
acceptance: Match header-name and citation-name models separately.
Preserve date normalized/textual fields and malformed/empty behavior.
Compare features, labels, parsed objects and raw service output fixtures.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port affiliation and address parser
acceptance: Port exact institution/department/address/country/email/token clustering behavior.
Retain raw text and nested fields with source spans.
Compare international, multi-affiliation, missing/ambiguous and whitespace examples.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port citation parser and bibliographic objects
acceptance: Match citation feature/label/data-object outputs including DOI/PMID/dates/authors.
Port required BiblioItem/Person normalization and null/empty semantics.
Verify individual/list citations, nonbreaking-space-only input and BibTeX cases.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Implement HTTP transport and admission shell
acceptance: Implement observed routing/negotiation/form/multipart/error shell with bounded work admission.
Preserve repeated fields and request defaults; capture loopback transport comparisons.
Development Java fallback if used is explicit and cannot count as S1.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Complete raw-text service vertical slices
acceptance: Run date/name/affiliation/citation/list endpoints against Java with all media variants.
Compare status/headers and semantic/raw bodies including errors.
Confirm these handlers run without a JVM and do not use fixture-specific responses.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port pdfalto subprocess lifecycle
acceptance: Reproduce flags/environment/temp/page/image/annotation options and mode-specific error mapping.
Handle exits 4/5/98, timeout, output limits and child group cleanup.
Test interrupted requests, full disk and cleanup without changing extractor.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port ALTO and sidecar parsers
acceptance: Match ordered pages/blocks/layout tokens, whitespace/fonts/coordinates and UTF-16 widths.
Handle annotations/outline/metadata and Java permissive-decoding cases.
Compare complete stage snapshots on edge and representative PDFs.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port document segmentation
acceptance: Match line-level features/document statistics and model outputs.
Preserve discontinuous zones, headers/footers/annex/bibliography boundaries.
Test long/empty/unusual block layouts and exact token-span mapping.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port header extraction pipeline
acceptance: Match selected pages/header vs fulltext differences and nested parsers.
Preserve titles/abstract/keywords/metadata/raw fields and coordinates.
Compare intermediate objects, fulltext-structured abstract and field-level output.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port reference segmentation and bibliography
acceptance: Match reference line→entry segmentation and nested citation parsing.
Preserve marker/raw text/order/coordinates and empty/unrecognized entries.
Verify multiline, multi-page, missing and duplicate bibliographies.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port citation callout resolution
acceptance: Reproduce numeric/author-year/unknown styles, bounded ranges and candidate ranking.
Match Lucene analyzer/query/tie behavior on ambiguous cases or keep gate blocked.
Assert every citation edge and target correspondence, not only citation text.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port body and annex fulltext parser
acceptance: Match token features, labels, clustering, section/paragraph/notes/callout structure.
Preserve body and annex ordering, statement labels and discarded-region rules.
Compare complete intermediate trees before serialization.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port figures tables equations and relabeling
acceptance: Port Kotlin LabelUtils and Java validation/reversion/ID behavior.
Preserve geometry, captions, table structures, equation labels and figure/table links.
Test adjacent starts, incomplete structures, annex overlap and retained paragraph text.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port author affiliation and metadata linking
acceptance: Match marker/name/email/ORCID affiliation assignment and ambiguity behavior.
Retain intended-but-unimplemented upstream cases as observations, not desired expectations.
Compare linked objects and author-affiliation evaluation fixtures.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Complete TEI and bibliography serializers
acceptance: Preserve mixed text/tails, namespaces, meaningful order, IDs/targets and provenance.
Port dates/raw fields/coordinates/BibTeX and all produced bibliographic variants.
Run strict/approved comparators and mutation controls across complete documents.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port coordinates and PDF annotations
acceptance: Match coordinate tags, page offsets, two-decimal textual and JSON numeric forms.
Implement annotation/link destinations and invalid-page behavior.
Compare PDF objects/overlays and annotation JSON with reviewed comparator.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port extracted assets and ZIP responses
acceptance: Preserve image conversion/member names/links and relevant SVG handling.
Match complete archive content and attachment headers.
Test duplicate/traversal resistance, limits and cleanup; record intentional safer differences.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Complete blank light and SDO flavors
acceptance: Verify blank/article-light/article-light-ref/IETF and asset-missing fallback semantics.
Trace actual model invocations, not only loaded models.
Compare all configured flavor/profile combinations; classify 3GPP separately by actual assets.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Complete funding and backmatter statements
acceptance: Match funding acknowledgements and availability/conflict/contribution extraction.
Preserve funder/grant/entity links and TEI placement.
Run rare-label fixtures and all statement-quality fields without aggregate masking.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port default language and sentence behavior
acceptance: Reproduce default Cybozu/OpenNLP and layout-aware protected-span corrections.
Verify spans, mixed TEI sentence boundaries and superscript citation placement.
Prove JVM-free runtime for these enabled helpers; block milestone if unavailable.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port consolidation with recorded responses
acceptance: Match Crossref/glutton request/enrichment/validation/mode/default behavior.
Cover replayed timeouts/rate limits/no-match/partial data and batch order.
Keep live integration separate, credentials absent from logs and benchmark modes matched.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Build pinned JVM-free DeLFT worker
acceptance: Pin Python/TensorFlow/DeLFT/embeddings/model preprocessing and framed IPC.
Preserve name/runtime overrides, label conversion/row reconstruction and serialized initial execution.
Test worker startup/crash/cancel/limits and complete process-tree resources.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Verify full DeLFT cascade profiles
acceptance: Match all six configured base DeLFT sequence models and inherited flavors.
Compare exact features/labels and end-to-end output at sequence/truncation/batch boundaries.
Keep evaluation config distinct; do not call full-profile skipped when dependencies fail.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Implement optional detectors and classifiers
acceptance: Cover Lingua/Pragmatic/BlingFire and enabled copyright/license classifier profiles.
Preserve default-disabled classifier behavior and threshold semantics.
Prove JVM-free execution or leave named optional profiles blocked.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Integrate remaining HTTP and debug features
acceptance: Wire all document/patent/annotation/assets/debug operations to real Rust behavior.
Preserve debug model output/count/error behavior and method/media variants.
Run route coverage against inventory; expose every still-missing handler.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Complete health metrics config and lifecycle
acceptance: Match readiness/liveness, config validation, model failure, CORS and overload semantics.
Handle graceful shutdown/startup/admin ports and service console assets.
Report runtime-specific metrics honestly with explicit deviation record.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port patent citation extraction and annotation
acceptance: Match TXT/ST36/PDF extraction, patent/nonpatent citations and annotation behavior.
Cover XML/gzip input semantics, context spans and normalization.
Run previously ignored upstream patent cases plus observed error mapping.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port training data and annotation generation
acceptance: Match model-specific SAX/TEI alignment, templates, feature rows and file naming.
Preserve example order, labels, raw inputs and XML ID/language behavior.
Compare generated training archives from PDF and direct corpora.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port trainer registry CLI and metrics
acceptance: Cover 26 recognized names/aliases/flavors and applicable command controls.
Implement metrics on fixed predictions including denominator/empty cases.
Inventory ineffective/legacy CLI branches with oracle probes and disposition.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Implement Wapiti training and model promotion
acceptance: Preserve training params, incremental model input and artifacts/loadability.
Test default/custom paths and .new/.old promotion/failure on disposable directories.
Train a tiny model and compare fixed-weight predictions in both implementations.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Implement DeLFT training and artifacts
acceptance: Match deterministic data/config/preprocessor/model artifact interfaces.
Run representative tiny training and successful reload/inference.
Measure repeatability separately from inference parity; do not require unjustified weight byte equality.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Complete split n-fold and evaluation runners
acceptance: Match recorded split membership or Java seeded shuffle exactly.
Implement train/eval/split/nfold and custom-path behavior with explicit quirk decisions.
Validate expected report/document counts, per-field metrics and no silent zero-exit failure.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Port async training job and lock lifecycle
acceptance: Match enqueue/token/list/status/alias-model locks and restart/stale job semantics.
Exercise cancel/kill/native worker lifetime and declared safety changes.
Reject traversal/bad tokens and verify states after success/failure/restart.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Complete model and training artifact downloads
acceptance: Match model ZIP format, filenames, media/status and missing model behavior.
Verify trained artifacts can load in appropriate reference/candidate engine.
Cover training-data ZIP file selection and cleanup.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Resolve batch CLI and Java embedding surfaces
acceptance: Inventory exposed legacy Java APIs and CLI commands with observable contracts.
Implement promised facade/FFI/CLI support or retain explicit scope decision/blocker.
Ensure optional Java client compatibility does not become a production server dependency.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Close complete service and feature coverage
acceptance: Require every current/optional route and feature row to map to executed cases.
Run full method/media/default/error/options matrix and all profiles without Java fallback.
List deviations and legacy decisions separately; no skipped mandatory feature is verified.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Run full labeled quality and held-out parity
acceptance: Run immutable four-corpus evaluation with actual expected counts on Java and Rust.
Require zero unexplained deterministic per-document drift and no hidden per-field regression.
Run held-out adverse cases and record every failure/mismatch/skip.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Fuzz and harden parser native boundaries
acceptance: Bounded fuzz ALTO/XML/features/multipart/ZIP/config and native ownership APIs.
Persist minimized reproducers and meaningful regression tests.
Validate no uncontrolled subprocess/resource behavior; document safety deviations.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Optimize measured dominant stages
acceptance: Select measured cost and one behavior-preserving optimization at a time.
Rerun relevant stage/output and full quality gates after each change.
Document failed hypotheses and memory/concurrency tradeoffs; no feature/model reduction.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Validate performance claims across profiles
acceptance: Run at least ten paired matched-work release rounds and confidence intervals.
Meet predeclared successful throughput/latency/memory/error targets or report parity-only result.
Include all processes, cold/warm and external-service modes; preserve raw observations.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Build platform artifacts notices and rollback
acceptance: Build/reproduce supported Linux/macOS architectures and asset/dependency manifests.
Include licenses/notices for code/models/data/native dependencies; verify JVM-free server image.
Create local release/rollback instructions and artifact hashes without unauthorized publishing.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Run sustained soak and recovery
acceptance: Run representative 24-hour soak then planned longer candidate workload with budgets.
Exercise overload/cancel/restart/worker failure and collect RSS/FD/child/temp/queue trends.
Require complete request accounting and bounded resources; do not mistake agent uptime for server soak.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs

tasks.title: Independently certify bounded release scope
acceptance: Fresh reviewer reconstructs provenance and reruns decisive held-out/contract/build checks.
Trace all required feature/profile rows to immutable evidence, review deviations and unsupported space.
Produce honest S0–S4 claim, actual measured speed, remaining risks and rollout/rollback package.
required_evidence: decisive commands and raw hashed logs
